message.content: Based on the conversation, LiHua will be responsible for ordering the pizza for the watch party. In the exchange, LiHua mentioned, "I can take care of the pizza order! Just let me know everyone's favorite toppings, and I'll make sure to get a variety." Additionally, LiHua noted that Giselle had requested no pineapple on her pizza, while others were open to various toppings. This indicates that LiHua will be coordinating the pizza order to accommodate these preferences. LiHua also expressed excitement about the upcoming watch party, saying, "This is going to be such a fun match day!"
